inferred.coordinate_frame: arena origin at centre; +x east, +y north; yaw CCW
inferred.note: Screenshot red paths and sign identities are inferred; do not treat them as surveyed coordinates.
inferred.obstacle_note: No obstacle placement is asserted from screenshots; optional route obstacles are ray-cast when supplied.

sensor_provenance.cadence: Controller.tick and the synthetic observation adapter run at fixed 20.000 Hz (dt 0.050 s) with ideal no-delay observations. Launch lane_hz=12.000 and ground_hz=8.000 are recorded only; their sensor-link cadence is not emulated, so this is not full sensor-link equivalence.
sensor_provenance.lane: fresh points projected from the mapped route centerline
sensor_provenance.obstacles: explicit course/route circles only; no screenshot placement is guessed
sensor_provenance.parking_slots: synthetic ground-truth metric bay poses projected into the current vehicle frame; explicit route identity is not visual recognition
